prompt: How many four-digit whole numbers have digits that are strictly increasing from left to right?
trap_note: Strictly increasing digits can never include 0, since 0 would have to lead, so the digits are a 4-subset of 1-9: C(9,4) = 126. Counting subsets of 0-9 instead gives C(10,4) = 210 -- a single wrong pool, one clean binomial, and no arithmetic slip to notice.
